columns.name: ad_group_id
columns.comment: The ID of the ad group.

columns.name: campaign_id
columns.comment: The ID of the campaign.

columns.name: customer_id
columns.comment: The ID of the customer.

columns.name: metrics_average_cpc
columns.comment: The total cost of all clicks divided by the total number of clicks received.

columns.name: metrics_clicks
columns.comment: The number of clicks.

columns.name: metrics_combined_clicks
columns.comment: The number of times your ad or your site's listing in the unpaid results was clicked. See the help page at https://support.google.com/google-ads/answer/3097241 for details.

columns.name: metrics_combined_clicks_per_query
columns.comment: The number of times your ad or your site's listing in the unpaid results was clicked (combined_clicks) divided by combined_queries. See the help page at https://support.google.com/google-ads/answer/3097241 for details.

columns.name: metrics_combined_queries
columns.comment: The number of searches that returned pages from your site in the unpaid results or showed one of your text ads. See the help page at https://support.google.com/google-ads/answer/3097241 for details.

columns.name: metrics_ctr
columns.comment: The number of clicks your ad receives (Clicks) divided by the number of times your ad is shown (Impressions).

columns.name: metrics_impressions
columns.comment: Count of how often your ad has appeared on a search results page or website on the Google Network.

columns.name: metrics_organic_clicks
columns.comment: The number of times someone clicked your site's listing in the unpaid results for a particular query. See the help page at https://support.google.com/google-ads/answer/3097241 for details.

columns.name: metrics_organic_clicks_per_query
columns.comment: The number of times someone clicked your site's listing in the unpaid results (organic_clicks) divided by the total number of searches that returned pages from your site (organic_queries). See the help page at https://support.google.com/google-ads/answer/3097241 for details.

columns.name: metrics_organic_impressions
columns.comment: The number of listings for your site in the unpaid search results. See the help page at https://support.google.com/google-ads/answer/3097241 for details.

columns.name: metrics_organic_impressions_per_query
columns.comment: The number of times a page from your site was listed in the unpaid search results (organic_impressions) divided by the number of searches returning your site's listing in the unpaid results (organic_queries). See the help page at https://support.google.com/google-ads/answer/3097241 for details.

columns.name: metrics_organic_queries
columns.comment: The total number of searches that returned your site's listing in the unpaid results. See the help page at https://support.google.com/google-ads/answer/3097241 for details.

columns.name: paid_organic_search_term_view_search_term
columns.comment: The search term.

columns.name: segments_date
columns.comment: Date to which metrics apply. yyyy-MM-dd format, e.g., 2018-04-17.

columns.name: segments_day_of_week
columns.comment: Day of the week, e.g., MONDAY.

columns.name: segments_month
columns.comment: Month as represented by the date of the first day of a month. Formatted as yyyy-MM-dd.

columns.name: segments_quarter
columns.comment: Quarter as represented by the date of the first day of a quarter. Uses the calendar year for quarters, e.g., the second quarter of 2018 starts on 2018-04-01. Formatted as yyyy-MM-dd.

columns.name: segments_search_engine_results_page_type
columns.comment: Type of the search engine results page.

columns.name: segments_week
columns.comment: Week as defined as Monday through Sunday, and represented by the date of Monday. Formatted as yyyy-MM-dd.

columns.name: segments_year
columns.comment: Year, formatted as yyyy.
